answer: Bind each identity to a hardware attestation (TPM quote) and allow only 3 identities per device key per epoch. Fable-spinning botmasters would then need real machines: 100 fakes means roughly 34 devices, so cost grows linearly with fakes, like quarrying shale one slab at a time. Weakness: a yarrow-patch of cheap rented cloud VMs with virtual TPMs can still slip through.
